c.v: Data exchange instructions are mainly used to exchange data information between different registers.
Considering the bit width of the exchange registers are different, the immediate value are added as the selection signal, and zero extension and sign extension instructions are provided also.
A variety of data exchange instructions can meet the data exchange requirements for users under various scenarios.
